subject.title: Feature: configurable /new greeting model (or option to suppress greeting)

question: Which public reset-greeting policy should OpenClaw support for bare `/new` and `/reset` across chat handlers, Gateway `agent`, bootstrap-aware prompts, startupContext, and model routing?
rationale: The request adds compatibility-sensitive config and model-routing surface while current main intentionally ships acknowledgement-only bare resets and related reports ask to restore model turns, so automation should not choose the product contract.

options.title: Define one reset-greeting policy
options.body: Create a single typed policy that covers ack-only, startup-turn, prompt customization, and optional model override, then update schema, docs, and tests together.

options.title: Keep ack-only default with opt-in greeting
options.body: Preserve the shipped cheap reset behavior and expose an explicit mode for persona workflows that need a model greeting.

options.title: Defer new config
options.body: Keep current static acknowledgements and leave prompt or startup-turn customization to the existing related discussions until maintainers sponsor the contract.

recommendation.title: Define one reset-greeting policy
recommendation.body: Create a single typed policy that covers ack-only, startup-turn, prompt customization, and optional model override, then update schema, docs, and tests together.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the current acknowledgement-only reset behavior and prior review of this compatibility-sensitive reset contract.
